name: Industrial
description: Machine parts, fasteners and raw plant stock.

name: Luxury
description: Fine goods for those who can afford the finer things.

name: Metal
description: Ingots and plate from the mines.

name: Vesk Glowmoss
description: A pale lichen from Tallow Rock that glows softly for a year after picking. Core households hang it in jars instead of lamps and swear it helps them sleep.

name: Halcyon Copperwine
description: A dry orchard wine the color of Halcyon's evening sea. Miners on the rim pay a week's wages for a bottle and drink it slowly.

name: Thistle Emberwool
description: Fleece from the slow red sheep of Thistledown, warm enough to keep a cold-docked pilot alive. Free Reach weavers will not sell the breeding stock at any price.

name: Stillwater Pearl
description: Grey-silver pearls grown in the still pools of Quiet Shoal, each with a faint glow like a held breath. Divers will only trade them to captains who found the place themselves.

name: Dimglass
description: Offcuts of lantern-glass, cooled slow and clouded grey from the Dimming. Concord collectors prize it because no one can say how it was made, and the people who sell it will not say either.

name: Unlicensed Stims
description: Pressed tablets that keep a hauler awake through three shifts. Concord and the Compact both ban them, and neither has ever stopped a crew from buying.

name: Dimming Relics
description: Scorched fittings and cracked lamp-cores pulled from the worlds that went dark. The Unlit call it grave-robbing and Concord calls it evidence tampering. Collectors elsewhere pay well.

name: Weapon Parts
description: Barrels, feed-springs and firing pins, sold by the crate with no questions asked. The settlements want fewer guns on the rim, and Concord wants an accounting of every one.
